item.title: Implement retry_budget.py to SPEC with focused tests
item.brief: Implement retry_budget.py according to SPEC.md. Preserve the documented API, handle every specified error and boundary case, and add focused tests beyond the existing basic coverage. Use only the Python standard library. Run appropriate tests and commit the completed work. Acceptance: behavior matches every specified API/error/boundary requirement in SPEC.md; focused tests cover omitted cases; tests pass; commit is created in the assigned worktree.

pr.body: Implemented the pure standard-library retry_delay function and added focused coverage for validation order, built-in integer type requirements, exhausted-attempt behavior, strict budget boundary, zero values, cap and uncapped Retry-After, and huge attempts. Full unittest suite passed (9 tests); compileall and git diff --check passed. No external dependencies or assumptions beyond SPEC.md.
pr.summary: Implemented the documented retry scheduling behavior. Before: retry_delay raised NotImplementedError; now it validates inputs, computes capped backoff safely, respects Retry-After and only starts retries strictly within budget.
